question: What buildable residential land is currently available within a 1.5-hour drive of Raleigh NC for Mabrey Construction's five build-ready customers, and how should a build-ready buyer actually find and vet land in each county? (RADIUS RULE, Joseph 2026-08-05: drive time <=90 min to Raleigh is the inclusion filter, not county membership.)
subQuestions: Which residential lots/land parcels (0.3-15 acres, ~$30k-$200k) are currently for sale in each target county (Wake, Johnston, Harnett, Franklin, Granville, Nash, Durham, Wilson, Cumberland, Hoke)?

Which channels actually surface NC land inventory — listed (land platforms, MLS-fed portals, auctions, FSBO) and off-market (GIS vacant-parcel mining, estate/probate, timber/farm brokers, developer remnants) — and which can only be worked by a human?

What makes an NC lot buildable — perc/septic approval, well vs municipal water, zoning and minimum lot size, road frontage, flood/wetlands — and what are the real costs and timelines per county right now?
County by county: who issues permits, where is the GIS/parcel portal, what are current septic-permit wait times, and how tight is lot inventory versus price?
How should the five customers be matched to inventory once their locations and budgets arrive from Sean?
checklist: lens coverage: FSBO (or honest human-channel flag)
buildability mechanics: septic/perc process + cost + timeline
buildability mechanics: well vs municipal water
buildability mechanics: zoning + minimum lot sizes
tier: custom-enhanced (Joseph-ordered): ~22-28 agents, Sonnet 5 bulk, Opus judge, Fable synthesis
stopCondition: Clean: all 10 counties saturated (2 consecutive dry lens-rotated rounds each) OR >=60 verified-live lots with every county swept >=2 rounds. Provisional: 30-agent floor or persistent tool degradation — gaps enumerated, never hidden.
